messages:
sahil: FYI customer hit double billing on a streaming + toolcall reconnection. short repro in staging.
priya: Ugh. Is it the reconnect path replaying the final chunk which contains the toolcall trigger?
lucas: Looks like: client resumed -> server replayed last chunk -> our router re-evaluated routing and fired toolcall again. ack_offset was sent as 2048 but the toolcall side is not idempotent.
anna: Can you paste the logs/snippet?
sahil: log snippet:
```
INFO session=sess_ABC123 route=eu-west-1 offset=2048 resumed=true prefetch=true
INFO toolcall fired tool_id=tts_v2 idempotency=null provisional_charge=true
INFO ack offset=2048 confirm=false
```
priya: Two problems: 1) we mark provisional_charge=true but don't reconcile on confirm, 2) our internal API for toolcalls lacks an idempotency key when invoked via stream replay.
lucas: And router can change route on reconnect, so the confirm might go to a different backend which doesn't see the provisional record.
anna: Billing UX: console shows two provisional credits then one confirmed — confusing to customers. We need a clear telmetry flag and dashboard filter for provisional vs confirmed charges.
billing-bot: Note: metric billing.provisional_charges.count incremented for sess_ABC123 at 3912345678
priya: Proposal: 1) Require service-generated toolcall_id for any toolcall emitted from the runtime. 2) Attach session_id + local_seq to provisional ledger entry. 3) On final ack, send confirm message with same toolcall_id to finalize ledger.
sahil: Implementation caveat: toolcalls triggered inside partial/truncated stream frames where client disconnects mid-response. If client reconnects and we replay a prefix, the runtime may re-evaluate prompt and re-emit toolcall. We need to ensure the replay path replays 'events' deterministically rather than re-evaluating.
lucas: Could also add a short lease TTL on provisional entries (e.g., 5s) and a reconciliation job to convert stale provisional -> refunded for failed confirms.
anna: Dashboard suggestion: add a column "provisional_window_ms" + link to session_id. Make the top-level route and final_confirm_backend visible.
priya: Telemetry keys to add to every streaming event: session_id, stream_seq, toolcall_id, provisional_flag, route_chosen, confirm_backend, ack_offset.
sahil: Quick patch idea: when firing toolcall during streaming, attach generated toolcall_id and write provisional ledger before dispatch. Router should sticky-hash by session_id so confirm hits same shard.
lucas: Sticky routing is risky for global failover but maybe okay for a canary. We should measure the added tail latency.
anna: For rollout/console UX: show provisional credits separately and expose a simple "reconcile" action for SREs to force-confirm or refund a given toolcall.
priya: Edge: what if the toolcall had side effects (e.g., external API charge) and confirm never arrives? We need idempotent retries at tool-service level or a compensation workflow.
sahil: Action items: (1) create infra ticket to add toolcall_id and telemetry (2) add provisional vs confirmed metrics + dashboard panel (3) add small reconciliation worker + metric alert for >0.1% unresolved provisional after 10s (4) spike sticky-routing perf impact
lucas: I'll open the infra PR for the runtime id assignment. will add unit test for replay determinism.
priya: I'll draft console mock for provisional column and nav flow.
anna: I'll own the reconciliation worker ticket and alert rule.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/stream-toolcall-id (staging) — started
sahil: Thanks all. temporary mitigation: disable client-side auto-reemit on reconnect for the affected customer until fix is deployed. :thumbsup:
